examples.task: Calculate the circumference of a circle with radius 3
examples.gen:
The circumference of a circle can be calculated using the formula:

$$ \text{Circumference} = 2 \times \pi \times \text{radius} $$

Given the radius is 3, the circumference is:

$$ \text{Circumference} = 2 \times \pi \times 3 = 6\pi $$

So, the circumference of the circle is $6\pi$ units.
